description:
Mujin is the future of industrial robotic systems in production and distribution environments. Our technology gives robots perception and awareness, enabling them to take on advanced tasks beyond simple pick-and-place. We aim to revolutionize robotics in industry, freeing human resources from labor-intensive work to focus on intellectual challenges.  

 
 


 As a  Software Developer   for  Robotics  at  Mujin , you will design and implement  cutting-edge  algorithms for real-time motion planning,  perception , and control of industrial robots.  You will develop  cutting-edge  robotics technology,  contribute to system architecture,  design, implement, and test algorithms, and  optimize performance for large-scale deployments. This role is ideal for someone passionate about robotics, automation, and pushing the boundaries of intelligent systems.   

   

 Position Description :    

 
 Design and develop software for motion planning, kinematics, and real-time  motion  control.   

 
 
 Build and  maintain  software layer that drives physical equipment – robot arms, conveyors, scanners , printers,  grippers  and   sensors  – including PLC handshaking and signal exchange   

 
 
 Implement and debug industrial communications – fieldbus and PLC protocols ( EtherCAT ,  EtherNet /IP, Modbus, OPC - UA), serial dev ices links (RS-232/RS-485) and digital and analog signals that drive hardware.   

 
 
 Architect and  optimize  software systems for industrial automation environments.    

 
 
 Integrate  Mujin’s  “ Teachless ” technology with major industrial robot arms (Fanuc, Yaskawa, ABB, etc.).    

 
 
 Write production-quality code that runs in real-time.  Deploy solutions in simulation and real-world environments   on   a scale .   

 
 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless  hardware software  integration.    

 
 
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in deployed systems.    

 
 
 Other duties as assigned   

 
   

 Position  Requirements:   

 
 Bachelor’s or  master's in computer science, Electrical  Engineering , Robotics, or related  fields, along with  working with Linux development environments and programming in C++ and  python .   
 

 End-to-end ownership of  systems  across design, implementations, test strategy,  deployment  and production support and  root cause analysis .   

 
 
 Experience in 3D motion planning and robot kinematics, along with automated testing using pytest or equivalent. 

 
 
 Experience with inter-process and networked communication: sockets, request/reply, publish/subscribe, and RPC. Hands-on experience with  ZeroMQ  and MQTT, or equivalent messaging libraries and brokers   

 Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, 3D rotations and transforms, coordinate frames, and rigid- body dynamics.   

 Networking fundamentals: TCP and UDP, ports, and latency and throughput trade-offs. Ability to capture network traffic with Wireshark,  tcpdump  or similar, and analyze the capture.   

 Prior industrial equipment or PLC integration experience or  demonstrated  ability to implement an unfamiliar  protocol from a specifications or packet capture    

 
   

 Preferred Qualifications:   

 
 Expertise  in  physics-based simulation  and  s imulation -first development  such as Gazebo, Isaac-Sim, or  MujoCo .   

 
 
 2+ years of experience using Python and C++ for high-performance applications.   

 
 
 Experience with real-time systems, distributed architecture, industrial  

 
 
 Experience with industrial  automation  and warehouse systems .   

 
 
 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices.   

 Remote operations on headless  linux  systems: SSH,  scp ,  rsync  , remote deployment and log retrieval.   

 
 



   Physical Demands/ Work Environment:     

 
 Travel Requirement:  Frequent  traveler : w illing to travel about  4 0% of the year as required by project demands   

 
 
 Work in both office and warehouse/manufacturing environments     

 Ability to work extended hours as required by project deliveries   

 
 


 Great Company! Great Benefits! When working with  Mujin , enjoy: 
   

 
 100%  Company  paid Medical, Dental, Vision plus the option to buy-up some benefits beginning the 1 st  of the month after  hire !     

 
 
 100% Company Paid Life Insurance & Voluntary Benefits    

 
 
 100% Company Paid Long and  Short Term  Disability    

 
 
 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) days beginning your 1 st  year!     

 
 
 11 Paid  Holidays ,  including (2) Floating Holidays!    

 
 
 401(k) Plan!    

 
 
 Parental Leave Benefits!    

 
 
 Health Savings Account (HSA)  option  with HDHP!    

 
 
 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options for Medical and Dependent Care!    

 
 
 Referral Bonuses!    

 
 
 Company Stock Options in many roles!    

 
   

 This Position Description is intended to describe the essential job functions, the general supplemental  functions  and the essential requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of all supplemental duties, responsibilities, or non-essential requirements.   

 



 Mujin is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.
